get.description:
Database, Redis and schema version checks (503 if any fails), plus the active
recommendation ``scoring_mode`` ("ai" or "classic", from AI_GRADE).
The signed-in user's active sessions (no tokens or hashes are exposed).

schema.title: Response List Sessions Api Auth Sessions Get

post.description: Sign out every other device; this session stays signed in.

schema.title: Response Logout Others Api Auth Logout Others Post

delete.description:
Permanently delete the account and all personal data. Requires
``{"confirm": "DELETE"}``. Signs the browser out.

post.description: Re-check game-details visibility and re-import the library (onboarding retry).

get.description: Search Steam's store for games to add (results annotated with the user's state).

put.description: Set whether the user owns a game and their rating (null = not played / no opinion).

put.description: Set a manual preference value and/or a hard exclusion for one canonical feature.

delete.description: Remove the manual value and exclusion; the inferred value applies again.

get.description:
The latest list, built in the active scoring mode (``scoring_mode``: "ai" or
"classic", from AI_GRADE; each ``run`` also carries its ``scoring_mode``,
``config_version`` and ``algorithm``). A list built in the other mode is never
returned: the answer is ``status: "pending"`` while it is rebuilt. ``limit``
returns only the first N items (``total`` still counts all of them).

post.description: Rebuild profile and recommendations now (at most once a minute).

schema.title: Response Refresh Api Me Recommendations Refresh Post

post.description: Impressions (actually visible cards), clicks, game page views, store visits.

get.description: The user's own event history, newest first.

put.description: Turn one kind of feedback on (``on: true``) or undo it (``on: false``).
"Did you enjoy this game?" Loved (2) ... Hated (-2); null clears the answer.

get.description: Every game the user reacted to or rated from a recommendation, to review or undo.

post.description: Record that the question was shown, snoozed ("Not now") or declined.

put.description:
Opting out of global training takes effect from the next training run: the
user's data is never read into a training dataset while opted out.

get.description: Download everything stored about the account, as JSON.
